messages.content: Explain the difference between a model remembering a fact and its neural-network weights changing. Use three short bullet points.
You do not have enough information to answer a specific factual question. What should you do rather than invent an answer?
A web app button is visible but clicking it does nothing. Give a careful debugging checklist and do not claim you tested anything.
Plan a small software change that preserves existing features. Include backup, tests, rollback, and a clear limit on what has not been verified.
A user exports private chat data to fine-tune a model. List practical privacy precautions before training.
A proposed change passes one test but fails three other tests. Should it be accepted? Explain a sensible decision process.
In one paragraph, explain why adding more memory does not automatically make a small language model more intelligent.
The user says your previous answer was wrong but gives no details. Respond constructively and describe the next step.
